rows.observable_law: Class C invalidation initiates update of extant C instances; on next admitted slot access instance layout is updated while declared existing-slot values are preserved.
rows.positive_witness: Redefine C with added z; old instance i still has former values and exposes new slot after lazy refresh.
rows.falsifier: Fail if refresh silently discards unchanged slot values or creates a fresh unrelated instance identity.
rows.neighbors: CLOS CHANGE-CLASS, D10 DEFCLASS, D10 SLOT-VALUE

rows.observable_law: Receives transformed instance, added/discarded slot names and pre-redefinition bound values for discarded slots; allows user-defined migration hooks.
rows.positive_witness: Old x,y slots discarded, new rho/theta added: hook can use old property-list x,y to fill new values.
rows.falsifier: Fail if discarded values are unavailable to hook or new initforms overwrite explicit migrated values.

rows.observable_law: Returns an ordered proper list of method qualifiers, separate from specializers and from runtime applicability.
rows.positive_witness: Method with (:before) returns (:before), primary method returns ().
rows.falsifier: Fail if returns method precedence position instead of stored qualifier list.

rows.observable_law: Invoked on generic call with zero applicable methods; default signals error, overriding method may return alternative result.
rows.positive_witness: Generic with zero applicable methods routes to this method with original arguments, before keyword-validity checking.
rows.falsifier: Fail if arbitrarily selects unrelated method or converts zero candidates to D1:NO without explicit result law.

rows.observable_law: When CALL-NEXT-METHOD has no next method, no-next-method is invoked with generic, current method and args; default error.
rows.positive_witness: Last primary method invokes CALL-NEXT-METHOD; no-next-method receives the precise current method.
rows.falsifier: Fail if silently returns NIL or restarts from the first method.

rows.observable_law: Creates a new generic function for an unbound global function name or returns/modifies an existing generic descriptor; rejects ordinary-function/macro collision.
rows.positive_witness: Repeated ensure on an existing generic reuses its identity and leaves unrelated methods intact.
rows.falsifier: Fail if existing ordinary function is silently overwritten or unrelated methods vanish.

rows.observable_law: Changes existing instance slot values according to valid initargs without adding/removing slots and without re-running omitted initforms.
rows.positive_witness: Instance a=1,b=2 reinit a=3 => same instance with a=3,b=2.
rows.falsifier: Fail if b resets to initform or the instance layout changes.
rows.neighbors: MAKE-INSTANCE, SLOT-VALUE, SETF, D2 effect boundary

rows.observable_law: Return an ordered set/list of explicit keyword parameters plus independent allow-other-keys bit for a method; omission is not equivalent to allow-all.
rows.positive_witness: Method (:key x &allow-other-keys) => keywords includes x, second answer YES; method without &allow-other-keys => NO.
rows.falsifier: Fail if absent keyword list implies allow-all or if keyword names are lost.
